_comment: Pinkan Island collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed pinkan-island-berry` (since #24 collections may share lines; picks take never-used lines first), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_pinkan.py.

readme.title: Pinkan Island
readme.summary: Pokemon turned pink by Pinkan Berries, like the Pokemon of the anime's Pinkan Island.
looks: each line wears one pink: classic Pinkan pink (Growlithe, Doduo, Zigzagoon); with Pinkan Berry clusters (Skwovet, Carbink, Cryogonal); pastel bubblegum (Alomomola, Espurr, Spheal); vivid hot pink (Scraggy, Honedge, Gastly); flamingo coral (Skrelp, Tentacool, Drampa); a Pinkan jungle-leaf print (Petilil, Tapu Koko, Venipede)
tiny pink sparkles twinkle; the eyes keep their own colours
